verdict.rationale: The docs mention item 'updates' and @mentions 'in any conversation', which implies in-tool conversation threads on work items, but these are only described for messaging AI agents. Team communication otherwise comes through integrations with Slack, Microsoft Teams and Gmail rather than a documented native chat. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of native person-to-person team chat or threaded discussion inside boards and items, real-time chat capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
